page_title.zh: 毛一鸣 Aiming — 具身智能

intro.en: Embodied intelligence, from data to model training.
intro.zh: 从数据到模型训练，探索具身智能。

bio.en: I work on embodied AI data and end-to-end model training at Pokebot. My research spans robotic manipulation, reward modeling, and 3D perception.
bio.zh: 我在 Pokebot 担任算法专家，主攻具身智能数据与全链路模型训练。研究工作涉及机器人操作、奖励建模与三维感知。

focus.en: I publish as Yiming Mao. Selected work includes ARM and CTRL.
focus.zh: 论文署名为 Yiming Mao，代表工作包括 ARM 和 CTRL。

projects.title: ARM: Advantage Reward Modeling for Long-Horizon Manipulation

summary.en: Learning relative advantage from three simple labels—progressing, regressing, and stagnant—to guide policy training for long-horizon manipulation.
summary.zh: 通过“前进、后退、停滞”三态标注学习相对优势奖励，为长时程机器人操作提供动作加权训练信号。

result.en: Reported 99.4% success on long-horizon towel folding with GR00T N1.5 + ARM (AW-BC), under the paper’s evaluation setting.
result.zh: 论文实验中，GR00T N1.5 + ARM（AW-BC）在长时程叠毛巾任务上达到 99.4% 成功率。

summary.en: Track-centric offline LiDAR 3D detection, combining bidirectional tracking and temporal refinement to improve automatic annotation.
summary.zh: 以轨迹为中心的离线 LiDAR 三维检测，结合双向跟踪与时序精修，提升三维检测和自动标注质量。

result.en: Evaluated on the Waymo Open Dataset. Full title: Once Detected, Never Lost: Surpassing Human Performance in Offline LiDAR based 3D Object Detection.
result.zh: 在 Waymo Open Dataset 上完成评测；完整论文题名与实验结果见下方论文链接。

description.en: The official implementation of CTRL is maintained in tusen-ai/SST. The repository includes training and evaluation instructions.
description.zh: CTRL 官方实现位于 tusen-ai/SST，仓库提供训练和评测说明。

description.en: Project overview, manipulation demonstrations, method details, and experimental results for ARM.
description.zh: ARM 项目介绍、机器人操作演示、方法细节和实验结果。

description.en: Embodied AI data and end-to-end model training.
description.zh: 具身智能数据与全链路模型训练。

title.zh: 数据、学习与机器人操作

description.en: Current interests include embodied AI data and model training. Published work covers reward modeling for long-horizon manipulation and offline LiDAR 3D detection.
description.zh: 当前关注具身智能数据和模型训练；已发表工作涉及长时程操作奖励建模与离线 LiDAR 三维检测。

description.en: Also known as Aiming / 毛一鸣. My GitHub account is aiming1998.
description.zh: 英文名 Aiming，中文名毛一鸣，GitHub 账号为 aiming1998。
